taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: GitHub Actions event/permission semantics; recheck repository configuration

controls.boundary: GitHub Actions event, checkout and runner trust — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read event triggers, checked-out ref, expression interpolation, token permissions, environment gates, actions pinning and runner lifecycle. Follow artifacts/caches from producer to privileged consumer.
controls.controlled_verification: Construct a local event-to-job trust trace for an untrusted PR or artifact. Determine whether privileged execution consumes attacker-controlled code/content before an actual approval/trust boundary. Inspect exact checkout/run binding; do not run untrusted workflows with a privileged token for proof.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: pull_request_target is not itself a finding. A privileged workflow that consumes only trusted code with correctly bound reviewed artifacts may be safe. A checkout SHA and an artifact name are different provenance claims.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Keep untrusted execution separate from privilege and bind promoted artifacts to trusted producer/run/digest. Retest normal contribution and the original untrusted-to-privileged path in an owned fixture.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
